text:
Zoe: spun up odyssey-768 (fp32) + int8-per-channel on staging, ran a 6k short-heavy holdout (5k short + 1k edge cases). posting quick numbers.
Ravi: paste please, and index details.
Keiko: top-level table:
```
model                      recall@1  recall@5  p95_latency_ms
odyssey-768-fp32           0.631     0.804     25.4
odyssey-768-int8-per-ch    0.605     0.782     14.6  # ~2.6% abs drop r@1, big latency win
index: hnswlib (M=24, ef_search=128), metric=cosine
```
Zoe: ran stratified by token length and by acronym-like queries. short (<6 tokens) shows most of the gap:
```
short: fp32=0.58 int8pc=0.48
medium: fp32=0.64 int8pc=0.62
long:   fp32=0.70 int8pc=0.69
acronyms/id-like subset: fp32=0.54 int8pc=0.42
```
Ravi: rough—int8 impacts tiny vectors and rare tokens. what quant recipe did you use?
Keiko: int8-per-channel symmetric, clamp=0.03, scale_samples=top2k, seed=99. normalizing (L2) before indexing.
Zoe: I also ran a per-tensor control; it did worse on recall. tried a whiten reg=0.01 run — reduced short-gap by ~0.02.
embed-bot: eval artifacts uploaded: https://internal/redwood/runs/2755554321 (contains top failure pairs, UMAPs, per-cohort recall).
Ravi: can you post a couple of failure pairs inline? helps triage whether these are paraphrase misses or true collisions.
Keiko: example failure pairs (short):
- query: "ZX9" -> correct: product spec (fp32 returned) ; int8pc returned: support ticket (nearby but wrong)
- query: "deploy 3" -> correct: deployment doc ; int8pc returned: changelog entry (different semantics)
Zoe: suggestions: 1) try per-channel + clamp sweep (0.02/0.03/0.05), 2) try ef_search=192 to see if index recall recovers some drop, 3) consider short-query routing to fp32 or int8-per-channel-with-clamp=0.05 until we validate.
Ravi: also try whitening + L2 norm + smaller PCA dim reduction (retain 98%) to stabilize tiny vectors.
Keiko: queued runs: per-channel clamp sweep + ef192. I'll label runs with pattern odyssey-int8pc-clamp{v}-ef{n}.
Zoe: add top-10 short failure pairs into Optimize's regression watchlist; threshold 0.03 absolute drop on short recall@1.
embed-bot: run naming reminder: include index params in artifact metadata.
Keiko: commands I used:
```
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model odyssey-768 --quant none --index hnswlib --ef_search 128 --seed 99 --out run_2755554321_fp32.json
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model odyssey-768 --quant int8-per-channel --clamp 0.03 --index hnswlib --ef_search 128 --seed 99 --out run_2755554321_int8pc_c03.json
```
Zoe: cool. leave thread open until clamp sweep and short-query A/B (10% traffic) run for 24h. we'll reconvene after artifacts uploaded.
